more_info.overview: Hydroxy propyl starch is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include unflavoured live fermented cream products and substitute products, both with a fat  content of less than 20 %. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Starch is etherified with propylene oxide. The product is a chemically modified carbohydrate.
